P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING.Purpose: Repository tooling project: the MSBuild build mechanism and the verification pipeline (containerized game runs, evidence) serving both product projects P-FLEXVERSE and P-FLEXTOOLS.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: MSBuild build configuration and deployment layout for all Source/ projects.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Verification pipeline: staging, game source, mod manager, containerized runs, evidence contracts. Verification truth claims — owned by the test suites M-XUNIT / M-PICKLE / M-EXPLORER; this project only runs commands and records evidence. Feature declarations (.feature files) — data of the verification plane; mods.json (mod registry, base set) is tooling input. Regenerable artifacts: .cache/, bin/obj, __pycache__, deployed Assemblies.

Principles.PRIN-001: Serve both product projects symmetrically; tooling never imports product semantics beyond marker contracts.
Principles.PRIN-002: Evidence is anti-false-green: exit code 0/1/2 separates pass/fail from harness-did-not-run; Player.log is the only primary source.
Principles.PRIN-003: Everything under .cache/ is regenerable; no durable state lives in caches.
Principles.PRIN-004: Commands are operations: each Scripts/ command is one semantic operation (test, play, and future build/package/deploy) over a shared kernel; a new operation is a new command, never a flag. Harness selection within `test` is by name from a closed registry.
Principles.PRIN-005: Local-first and CI-identical: the gate is one command on a laptop and in CI; environment differences live in --profile and environment variables, never in code branches.
Principles.PRIN-006: Selection of the external world is by name from data: each seam with multiple implementations exposes a name -> implementation registry chosen by --profile; unknown names fail loudly; single-implementation seams stay plain functions.

Technology.TECH-001: MSBuild for build configuration; dotnet CLI for builds and offline tests.
Technology.TECH-002: Python via uv (`uv run Scripts/test`); docker containers for game runs.
Technology.TECH-003: steamcmd for CI game source, selected by --profile with credentials from environment variables only.

P-FLEXVERSE-TOOLING.Codemap: * `Directory.Build.props` + `Scripts/{test,play}` + `Scripts/_lib.py` (sections core|dotnet|game|runs|ops) : children ; command files declare their own pipeline order * `M-FV-CORE` + `M-DOTNET` + `M-GAME` + `M-RUNS` ; `S-VERIFICATION` -> `M-OP-TEST` + `M-OP-PLAY` * `DeployToModFolder` -> `Mods/{mod}/Assemblies/` => product mods * `Scripts/{test,play}` -> `game_pipeline` -> `Pipeline` -> `_lib.py` sections -> `dotnet build` -> `DeployToModFolder` * `run_test` -> `Player.log` -> `write_report` => `report.json` (typed Verdict) * `evidence.grep('[FV][M-')` <= `FlexVerse.Log` : marker contract * `uv run Scripts/test all` : the gate, invoked by humans and CI runners alike
